capabilities: Render ==highlight== text as procedural pen strokes
Draw a separate stroke on each wrapped line
Color strokes to match Obsidian's colored highlights
Toggle highlights and realistic rendering with commands
Adjust presets, pen colors, opacity and texture in settings
disambiguation: Not a highlight-extraction or annotation tool; it only restyles existing ==highlight== text.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer; colored highlights need a version that supports them (1.15.1 does, 1.13.7 does not). Mobile is untested. Developer documentation is in German in docs/development.md.
intentEvidence: Uses Obsidian's native ==highlight== syntax. Your notes are never changed – disable the plugin and you get the regular highlights back.
problem: Obsidian's default highlights are flat colored blocks that do not look like marks made by a real highlighter pen.
summary: Renderer that turns Obsidian ==highlight== text into procedural highlighter-pen strokes with organic edges, chisel tips and ink texture.
